pay.title: Pay
pay.allowance: You can pay up to {{amount}} {{symbol}} without internet.
pay.noAllowance: Add money to pay without internet.
pay.discardWarning: That part of your offline balance may stay on hold.
pay.setup: Finish setting up this phone to pay.

scan.hint: Hold your camera on the code on the other phone's screen.
scan.wrongCode: That code isn't a payment request. Ask the other phone to show a request.
scan.unreadable: Couldn't use that request ({{code}}). Cancel, then scan it again.
scan.timedOut: The other phone didn't send a request. Keep the phones close, then cancel and try again.
scan.wrongPayment: That code isn't a payment. Ask the payer to show their payment.
scan.receiptHint: Hold your camera on the confirmation on the other phone's screen.

review.title: Pay {{amount}} {{symbol}}
review.compare: Compare this code with the one on the other phone's screen.
review.noteWarning: Written by the other phone. Buckspay hasn't checked it.
review.finalForThem: The other phone gets this payment as soon as you tap Pay. You can't cancel it afterwards.
review.nothingLeaves: Your money isn't taken until the payment reaches their wallet. If it never does, it stays in your reserve.
review.ifRefused: If the other phone refuses it, you can show the same payment again, but not send it to anyone else. That part of your offline balance stays on hold until your reserve ends.
review.includesFee: Includes {{fee}} {{symbol}} to cover the fees of crediting it.
review.bondAnswers: If you spend the same money twice, you lose your security deposit.
review.ifRefusedReceived: If the other phone refuses it, you can show the same payment again, but it can't be sent to anyone else.
review.fingerprint: You'll be asked for your fingerprint or screen lock.
review.hops_one: It can be passed on 1 more time
review.hops_other: It can be passed on {{count}} more times

UnknownMint.text: This request is for a currency Buckspay doesn't support.

SelfPayment.text: This request is from your own phone.

AboveYourLimit.text: This is more than the {{max}} you can pay at once.

ClockOrExpired.text: This request is old, or the two phones' clocks don't match. Check that both use automatic date and time, then ask for a new request.

NoLock.text: You have no offline balance in this currency. Add money while you're online.

AttesterNotTrusted.text: The other phone can't check your proof of funds yet. It needs to go online once to update.

BondTooSmall.text: Your security deposit is too small for {{amount}}. Add money, or pay less.

AllowanceTooLow.text: You only have {{allowance}} left to pay offline. Add money while you're online.

LockTooShort.text: Your offline balance ends too soon for this payment. Add money while you're online to renew it.

TicketStale.text: Your proof of funds needs a refresh. Connect to the internet once, then try again.

send.title: Show this to the other phone
send.codeLabel: QR code for your payment of {{amount}} {{symbol}}. Hold it in front of the other phone's camera.
send.unconfirmed: The other phone hasn't confirmed, but the payment may have reached it: check that phone before trying again. That money stays on hold until it is confirmed or discarded.
send.keepUp: Keep this screen up until the other phone says Received.
send.confirmed: Paid {{amount}} {{symbol}}. The other phone confirmed it.
send.confirmedSpoken: Paid {{amount}} {{symbol}}. The other phone confirmed it.
send.rejected: The other phone didn't accept this payment: {{reason}}.
send.rejectedNext: Nothing was paid, and your money is still in your reserve. You can show the same payment again, but not send it to anyone else; {{amount}} {{symbol}} stays on hold until {{date}}.
send.otherPayment: That confirmation is for a different payment.

payError.NoScreenLock: To pay {{amount}} {{symbol}} or more, set a screen lock first. No money moved.
payError.Locked: Unlock your phone, then tap Resume.
payError.NoKey: This phone can't make payments right now. You can reset its identity, but payments not yet credited to you are lost.
payError.SignFailed: Couldn't complete the payment. Tap Resume to try again.
payError.SendFailed: Couldn't show the payment. Tap Resume.
payError.IntervalTaken: This payment is already in progress. Wait a moment, then check History.
payError.Mismatch: Something went wrong with this payment. It wasn't sent: try again, or ask for a new request.

receive.title: Get paid
receive.invalidAmount: Enter an amount above zero, up to {{max}}.
receive.limits: You can get up to {{max}} per payment. The payment has to stay valid for at least {{window}}.
receive.bondLimit: How much you can accept from one person depends on their security deposit, until the payment is credited to you.
receive.minimum: Payments of {{amount}} or more are credited to your wallet as soon as you're online.
receive.transportFailed: Couldn't start {{medium}}. Try QR code instead.
receive.connectOnce: Connect to the internet once so this phone can check payers' proofs of funds.
receive.setup: Finish setting up this phone to receive.

requestTitle.qr: Ask the payer to scan this code
requestTitle.nearby: Keep the phones close and wait for the payer

receive.requestLabel: QR code for a request of {{amount}} {{symbol}}
receive.payerSeesCode: The payer sees this code too
receive.scanning: Hold your camera on the code on the payer's screen.
receive.yours: It's yours now. It will be credited to your wallet when this phone is online.
receive.yoursPassOn: It's yours now. You can use it in your next payment; if you don't, it's credited to your wallet within a day.
receive.bondNote: If the payer spends this money twice, their security deposit is destroyed. Uninstalling the app loses payments not yet credited to you.
receive.already: Already received. Nothing was added twice.
receive.receiptLabel: QR code that confirms the payment to the payer
receive.passOnHelp: Use it to pay someone else, even offline. If you don't, it's credited to your wallet within a day.

reason.1: Couldn't read this payment. Ask the payer to show it again.
reason.2: This payment isn't valid. Ask the payer to make a new one.
reason.3: This payment couldn't be verified. Ask the payer to try again.
reason.4: This phone can't check the payer's proof of funds. Ask the payer to connect to the internet once, then try again.
reason.5: This payment has expired. Ask for a new request.
reason.6: This payment expires too soon to be credited. It must stay valid for at least {{window}}: ask for a new request.
reason.7: This payment is for a different phone. Ask for a new request.
reason.8: This phone can't accept this payment. Try another way of paying.
reason.9: This payer already used that money for another payment, so nothing was received. Ask them to pay with other money.
reason.10: This payer has reached the most this phone accepts from one person. Ask for a smaller amount.
reason.11: This is more than the {{max}} this phone accepts in one payment. Ask for a smaller amount.
reason.12: This phone couldn't save the payment, so nothing was received. Try again.
reason.13: Someone who held this money before spent it twice, so nothing was received. Ask the payer to pay with other money.
reason.14: The fees of crediting this payment would leave you with less than you asked for, so nothing was received. Ask for a little more.

lost.title: Spent twice before it reached you.
lost.culprit: The person at step {{step}} of {{steps}} (code {{code}}) spent it twice.
lost.issuer: The first payer (code {{code}}) promised more money than they had.
lost.burned: Their security deposit of {{amount}} {{symbol}} was destroyed. You are not repaid from it.
lost.late: Reported too late: nothing was destroyed. You are not repaid.

activity.title: History

status.conflicted: Not paid: another payment of the same money was credited first
status.relay-waiting: Waiting for a phone with internet

activity.serverCannot: The server can't take this payment.
activity.serverBusy: The server is busy. This phone will try again.

serverReasons.float_cap: The server has reached its limit of payments it can credit for now.
serverReasons.daily_cap: The server has reached today's limit of payments it can credit.
serverReasons.lock_share: This payer's reserve is already backing as many credits as it can.
serverReasons.too_many_locks: The server is already handling as many reserves as it can.
serverReasons.issuer_locks: This payer already has as many reserves on the server as allowed.
serverReasons.unavailable: The server can't record payments right now.
serverReasons.expired: The server dropped this payment before sending it.
serverReasons.paused: Private crediting is paused on the server.
serverReasons.cap: The server has reached its limit of private credits for now.
serverReasons.network_busy: This network is sending the server too many payments at once.
serverReasons.network_limit: This network has reached its limit of payments for the day or month.
serverReasons.key_limit: This payer has reached the limit of payments that can be credited for the day or month.
serverReasons.lock_limit: This payer's reserve has reached today's limit of credits.
serverReasons.too many requests: This phone asked the server too often.

activity.serverMinimum: This payment is below the smallest amount the server credits for free. You can credit it yourself from your wallet for a small network fee.
activity.stalledSign: This phone couldn't complete the credit. Unlock it, then tap Credit now.
activity.stalledOffline: The server couldn't be reached. This phone will try again.
activity.waitsForYou: Waiting for you. Crediting this payment in the open shows who held the money before you.
activity.privateProving: This phone is preparing a private credit, so the people who held this money before you stay hidden.
activity.needsWallet: This phone is not registered to a wallet yet, so it can't credit payments.
activity.noServer: This version of the app has no server to credit payments.
activity.passOnUntil: You can use this to pay someone else until {{time}}. Then it's credited to your wallet.
activity.noTokenAccount: Your wallet has no USDC account yet
activity.serverLater: The server will take this one after {{time}}
activity.expiredNote: This payment can no longer be credited. The payer may take it back.
activity.codeHelp: Check that it matches the other person's phone.
activity.walletFailed: Your wallet could not credit this payment. Nothing was charged; try again.

settlement.labelBody: Crediting this payment in the open makes public who held the money, every amount, and the wallet that receives it. Buckspay's server also sees the payment, your network address and the time.
settlement.noticeOne: Crediting this payment in the open makes public who held the money before you, and the amounts.
settlement.noticeMany: Crediting this payment in the open makes public the {{count}} people who held the money before you, and the amounts.
settlement.waiting_one: 1 payment is waiting to be credited. Do it by {{date}}.
settlement.waiting_other: {{count}} payments are waiting to be credited. Do it by {{date}}.

reset.title: Reset this phone's identity?
reset.newKey: This phone gets a new key. The old key is deleted and can't be recovered.
reset.lost: Payments you received and that aren't credited yet are lost, because they belong to the old key. The people who paid you can take them back after {{date}}.
reset.registration: Your wallet will register the new key, which costs about 0.0016 SOL that Buckspay pays when it can. The old registration stays on Solana for good.
reset.lockStays: Your reserved money stays yours. You can withdraw it with your wallet when its reserve ends.
reset.none: No payments are waiting to be credited.
reset.promptSubtitle: This deletes the key of this phone
reset.done: This phone has a new identity.
reset.failed: Couldn’t reset this phone. Try again.

settings.biometricDaily: Fingerprint asked from a day total of
settings.window: Payments you receive must stay valid for
settings.uninstallBody: Uninstalling this app loses payments that aren't credited yet. You have {{count}} right now.
